name: ualet
description: ualet connects Claude to your personal financial data, synced from Chilean bank accounts and cards. Ask about monthly spending, budgets, trends, and recurring merchants. List uncategorized transactions and suggest categories for you to review and confirm in the ualet app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ualet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ualet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ualet.cl/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ualet MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ualet provides these MCP tools: compare_spending, get_account_overview, get_budget_status, get_categories, get_daily_spending, get_spending_summary, get_top_merchants, list_pending_categorization, search_transactions, and suggest_category.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ualet?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ualet in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
ualet requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ualet is developed by Ualet SpA. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
